raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SGLang gives `LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M` two BOS tokens on text-only chat, Responses and Anthropic messages requests. This fix changes its prompt ids from `[1, 1, 6, ...]` to `[1, 6, ...]`, matching `/v1/tokenize`. Two other LFM2 VL models, Gemma 3 with `--enable-multimodal`, Llama 3.2 Vision and Nemotron Nano VL behave the same, and Gemma 4 joins them once #41204 lands.

The measured cost is one extra input token per text-only request and a prompt that differs from the chat template output. Some text-only answers also changed, but run variation was not ruled out. GSM8K on `LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-1.6B` shows no regression or improvement, because scores on one tree vary by up to 2.5 points.

Merged #26505 fixed this doubling only for media requests. Open PR #30876 (not run) would also remove it, but it conflicts with main and has been idle since July.

On a multimodal model, `_engine_prompt` sends decoded text, and `TokenizerManager` re-encodes it with default specials, so an auto-adding tokenizer doubles the chat template's BOS.

| Model | Evidence and flags | Plain chat before (ids, input tokens) | Plain chat after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M`, `LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-1.6B`, `LiquidAI/LFM2-VL-1.6B` | B200 server, `--attention-backend flashinfer --mm-attention-backend fa4`. The default backend fails at startup on B200 | `[1, 1, 6, ...]`, 23 | `[1, 6, ...]`, 22 |
| `unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it` | B200 server, `--attention-backend triton --enable-multimodal` | `[2, 2, 105, ...]`, 23 | `[2, 105, ...]`, 22 |
| `unsloth/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct` | B200 server, `--attention-backend flashinfer` | `[128000, 128000, ...]`, 49 | `[128000, 128006, ...]`, 48 |
| `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL-BF16` | B200 server, `--attention-backend flashinfer --mm-attention-backend fa4`. `continue_final_message` also changes the prompt tail, and the new ids match `/v1/tokenize` | `[1, 1, 10, ...]`, 29 | `[1, 10, ...]`, 28 |
| `unsloth/gemma-4-E2B-it` with #41204, so this fix should land before or with #41204 | B200 server, `--attention-backend triton` | `[2, 2, 105, ...]`, 23 | `[2, 105, ...]`, 22 |
| `unsloth/gemma-4-E2B-it` today, and `unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it` without `--enable-multimodal` (multimodal is off by default) | B200 server, `--attention-backend triton` | `[2, 105, ...]`, 22 | same |
| `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct` | B200 server, tokenizer does not auto-add specials | no BOS, 21 | same |
| `unsloth/gemma-3n-E2B-it` | Tokenizer check only. The server fails at startup with and without this fix: `RuntimeError: mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied (2176x256 and 2048x2048)` | `[2, 2, 105, ...]` | not run |
| GLM-4.6V, MiniMax-M3 and InternVL (no auto-add), `mistral_common` tokenizers (already send ids) | Tokenizer check only | no doubled BOS | not run |
| Janus Pro, DeepSeek-OCR, Unlimited-OCR, LLaVA v1.5, MiniCPM-V 4 | Tokenizer check only. The built-in conversation template writes no BOS, so the prompt keeps the BOS from the tokenizer | one BOS | not run |
| ERNIE-4.5-VL, Kimi-VL, MiniCPM-o, Step3-VL, Ling-3.0-flash-VL, LocateAnything, Phi-4-multimodal | Not checked: these repositories need remote code or failed to load | not run | not run |
| Moss-VL | Traced in the code only. Its conversation template gives no prompt ids, so it does not reach the new branch. A Jinja `--chat-template` on an auto-adding tokenizer could reach it | not run | not run |

## Modifications

`_engine_prompt` sends the encoded ids when a request has no media, the tokenizer auto-adds specials, and the ids start with the BOS. Prompts without a leading BOS keep the text path and the tokenizer's BOS. Raw `/generate` text does not change.

## Accuracy Tests

These results are from before I squashed this branch onto main `7b88f09239`. The squash kept the same diff, and I did not repeat these runs on it. On the squashed commit, only pre-commit and `test_chat_prompt_round_trip.py` ran, on CPU, and the test file found no failure.

GSM8K ran with sgl-eval 0.1.3 on `LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-1.6B` with the cookbook backends, `--mem-fraction-static 0.5`, 200 examples, max tokens 512 and seed 0.

- Temperature 0: 68.00%, 69.00%, 66.50% before and 69.50%, 68.50%, 69.50% after. Only the first pair set the IPC env vars.
- Temperature 0.1 (cookbook value), with both env vars: 67.00% before and 68.00% after.

sgl-eval has no flags for `min_p` and `repetition_penalty`.

Image prompt ids stay identical. Image answers matched, except the last tokens in one Nemotron and one LFM2.5-VL-450M run.

The new server and unit tests fail before the fix. With it, they and `TestLfm2VlServer` pass on the cookbook backends.

Not checked: `TestLfm2VlServer` on H100, text models (traced only), PD or EPD disaggregation, the Rust frontend, any server on main after `cbfc0932e3`, and the cause of the variation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No documentation describes this behavior.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). The accuracy results are above. Speed was not measured.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -1248,13 +1248,23 @@ def _engine_prompt(
         pre-rendered input_ids with single placeholder ids and leave the text
         empty; pass those through rather than re-tokenizing an empty prompt.
         """
-        # A lossy text round-trip makes the rendered prompt unusable, so send the
-        # ids instead. Only when nothing needs placeholder expansion: with media
-        # attached the MM processor still has to tokenize the text itself.
+        # A lossy text round-trip makes the rendered prompt unusable, and a tokenizer
+        # that auto-adds specials puts a second BOS on text whose template already
+        # wrote one. Send the ids instead in both cases. Only when nothing needs
+        # placeholder expansion: with media attached the MM processor still has to
+        # tokenize the text itself.
+        prompt_ids = processed_messages.prompt_ids
         prefers_prompt_ids = (
-            self._prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy
-            and isinstance(processed_messages.prompt_ids, list)
-            and processed_messages.prompt_ids
+            isinstance(prompt_ids, list)
+            and prompt_ids
+            and (
+                self._prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy
+                or (
+                    self._tokenizer_auto_adds_specials
+                    and prompt_ids[0]
+                    == getattr(self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer, "bos_token_id", None)
+                )
+            )
             and not (
                 processed_messages.image_data
                 or processed_messages.video_data

@@ -91,9 +91,14 @@ def test_lossy_tokenizer_encodes_straight_to_ids_without_a_text_render(self):
 
 
 class TestEnginePrompt(unittest.TestCase):
-    def _server(self, lossy):
+    def _server(self, lossy, auto_adds_specials=False):
         return SimpleNamespace(
-            _prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy=lossy, chat_encoding_spec=None
+            _prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy=lossy,
+            _tokenizer_auto_adds_specials=auto_adds_specials,
+            tokenizer_manager=SimpleNamespace(
+                tokenizer=SimpleNamespace(bos_token_id=1)
+            ),
+            chat_encoding_spec=None,
         )
 
     def test_lossy_text_only_sends_ids(self):
@@ -119,6 +124,22 @@ def test_non_lossy_multimodal_is_unchanged(self):
         self.assertEqual(key, "text")
         self.assertEqual(value, "rendered")
 
+    def test_auto_added_bos_is_not_added_to_a_templated_bos(self):
+        # Encoding the text would add a second BOS, so the ids go to the engine.
+        server = self._server(False, auto_adds_specials=True)
+        key, value = engine_prompt(server, _messages([1, 3, 4]), is_multimodal=True)
+        self.assertEqual((key, value), ("input_ids", [1, 3, 4]))
+
+        # With media, the MM processor tokenizes the text and adds no second BOS.
+        key, _ = engine_prompt(
+            server, _messages([1, 3, 4], image_data=["img"]), is_multimodal=True
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(key, "text")
+
+        # A template that writes no BOS relies on the one that the tokenizer adds.
+        key, value = engine_prompt(server, _messages([3, 4]), is_multimodal=True)
+        self.assertEqual((key, value), ("text", "rendered"))
+
     def test_lossy_without_ids_falls_back_to_text(self):
         key, _ = engine_prompt(self._server(True), _messages([]), is_multimodal=True)
         self.assertEqual(key, "text")

@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@
 
 import openai
 from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
 
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
@@ -67,6 +68,29 @@ class TestLlavaServer(ImageOpenAITestMixin):
 class TestLfm2VlServer(ImageOpenAITestMixin):
     model = "LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-1.6B"
 
+    def test_text_only_prompt_keeps_a_single_bos(self):
+        """The chat template writes the BOS and the tokenizer auto-adds one, so a
+        text-only prompt that is encoded a second time starts with two BOS tokens.
+        """
+        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "What is 2+2?"}]
+        expected = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model).apply_chat_template(
+            messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=False
+        )
+        client = openai.Client(api_key=self.api_key, base_url=self.base_url)
+
+        chat = client.chat.completions.create(
+            model=self.model,
+            messages=messages,
+            max_tokens=1,
+            extra_body={"return_prompt_token_ids": True},
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(chat.choices[0].prompt_token_ids, expected)
+
+        response = client.responses.create(
+            model=self.model, input=messages, max_output_tokens=16
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.usage.input_tokens, len(expected))
+
 
 class TestQwen25VLServer(ImageOpenAITestMixin, VideoOpenAITestMixin):
     model = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct"
